scope: Preserve closed activation cancellation provenance, avoid unchanged authority CAS writes, and reserve two bounded assignment slots before Preview refresh.
riskAnalysis: No lease, request, token, spending or publication authority expands. Fresh checks still run; unchanged verification avoids CAS. Assignment registry increases from64 to96 without deletion or new provider; bounded retrieval scans up to32 additional historical rows only. Provider storage/request failures remain authoritative.

threatModel.assets: Task and release authority, immutable history, spending, credentials and revocation.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Existing authenticated owner/controller and trusted fixed-code broker; model output and arbitrary abort reasons cannot authorize execution.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged abort metadata, expired/revoked authority, stale concurrent writes, cross-workspace admission and refresh with no live-task slot.
threatModel.mitigations: Closed origin/code pairs; fresh active checks; unchanged atomic dispatch/renewal checks and30s leases; bounded96-plan registry; two-slot refresh preflight; preserved CAS/history.

rollback: Revert reviewed platform changes to the prior paid-disabled Preview; retain failed attempt, reservations, configuration chain and all assignment history. Never revive approvals or remove persisted records.

defects.rootCause: Ordinary authority verify used a normal transaction and wrote unchanged full ledger state. Outer activation abort discarded its closed origin before transport persistence. Refresh preflight reserved one slot although configuration preparation plus a fresh live task need two.
defects.detectionGap: Prior successful fixtures used low-latency adapters and did not assert no-op CAS counts or distinguish outer cancellation causes. Historical cancellation exact cause remains unproven.
defects.regression: Independent12 cancellation/actual-broker tests,4 registry history/concurrency/boundary tests, existing transport/failure/lifecycle and STRICT release suite.
defects.historicalPrevention: Preserve closed cancellation provenance before cleanup, assert actual no-op writes, and check complete preparation-plus-live capacity before configuration.

proactiveReview.architecture: Reuse existing controller, broker, transaction no-op option and assignment registry; no competing journal or gateway.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No dependency, credential, infrastructure or model changes.
proactiveReview.threats: Arbitrary exception text, forged diagnostics, stale/revoked authority, concurrent history loss or unauthorized task admission.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Any authority failure still cancels. Historical exact trigger remains unknown; performance repair is not proof of its cause. Existing inner heartbeat exact error remains unretained.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Delayed/throwing renewals, external aborts, arbitrary secret-like reasons, revoked authority, concurrent appends, duplicate/stale/cross-workspace operations and exhausted registry.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Work QA authored isolated tests; Engineering Auditor reviews actual changes and evidence. Automated criticism is not independently authenticated acceptance.
proactiveReview.recovery: Preserve original failed attempt and pending uncertainty; source repair must pass reviewed release/configuration gates before any fresh one-time attempt.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused tests then STRICT, Redis, CI, CodeQL and actual authenticated Browser artifact before paid admission.
